newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee volume hits new record in January.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee volume hits new record in January.

text.p: LIFFE coffee futures volume set a new monthly record of 185,720 contracts in January, surpassing the previous record of 155,299 contracts in May 1994, LIFFE said.
In comparison, a total of 105,759 coffee contracts were traded in December last year.

Coffee futures prices surged by 30 percent in January on the back of strong funds and trade buying on lower-than-expected estimates of Brazil's 1997/98 crop, a cut in export quotas by key producers and a dockworkers' strike in Colombia.
LIFFE said the exchange's commodity futures traded 419,395 contracts in January, the highest monthly volume since LIFFE merged with the London Commodity Exchange last September 16.
Cocoa futures volume rose to 133,556 contracts in January from 105,759 in December while white sugar rose to 56,217 from 29,741. -- Jalil Hamid, London newsroom +44 171 542 4985
